stories.headline: Allies beginnen dringende Sicherheitsgespräche
stories.summary: Atlantic allies opened emergency talks after a rapid deterioration in regional security. Officials said the meeting would focus on civilian protection, diplomatic channels, and immediate measures to prevent further escalation, while warning that negotiations remained at an early and uncertain stage.

stories.headline: Markets reassess rate outlook
stories.summary: Global markets shifted as investors weighed fresh inflation data against cautious central bank guidance. Bond yields moved higher, while analysts said the figures reduced expectations for rapid interest-rate cuts this year.

stories.headline: Berlin beschleunigt wichtige Bahnreparaturen
stories.summary: Berlin transport officials advanced repairs on a heavily used rail corridor after engineers found additional structural wear. Revised service plans add replacement buses and extend evening work to shorten the disruption.

stories.headline: Europa verschärft Regeln für Cloud-Sicherheit
stories.summary: European regulators issued detailed security requirements for cloud services used by critical sectors. Providers must strengthen incident reporting, supply-chain controls, and resilience testing under a phased compliance timetable.

stories.headline: Cities expand heat response plans
stories.summary: Cities across southern Europe expanded cooling centres and health alerts as temperatures rose. Authorities prioritised older residents, outdoor workers, and neighbourhoods with limited shade during the prolonged heat spell.

stories.headline: Impfstoffstudie meldet ermutigende Ergebnisse
stories.summary: Researchers reported encouraging results from a large late-stage vaccine trial, with fewer severe cases among participants receiving the treatment. Independent reviewers said longer follow-up remains necessary before regulators consider approval.
